decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-e2524c52924c], is a one-line changelog title. It says the argocd CLI now uses the "correct CA" when adding "kube-public clusters". It doesn't say which CA was used before, which clusters count as "kube-public" (for example, those whose CA comes from the kube-public cluster-info ConfigMap), or which cluster-add invocations hit the bug, so applicability can't be written. It also doesn't say what the bug did to an exposed operator (TLS verification failure, an unusable cluster secret, or a silently wrong trust anchor), so consequence can't be set. The linked issue/PR (#21326/#21327) or the code diff is needed to fill these two aspects.
